books.title: Great House Farm (Tŷ Mawr), Llandough — The Wiki
books.subtitle: The Legal Wiki as a book
books.description: The Great House Farm Legal Wiki as one book: evidence register, timeline, judgments, conveyances, maps, correspondence, history and heritage.
books.whats_new: 0.2.0: focused on evidence, history and heritage. Order forms, templates, admin, navigation and duplicate pages removed; 18 new evidence pages (EV-0239 to EV-0255 and the disclosure escalation map) added.

books.title: Fraud, Concealment and Government Involvement
books.subtitle: Great House Farm / Tŷ Mawr — our case and lines of enquiry
books.description: Fraud, concealment and government involvement at Great House Farm (Tŷ Mawr), Llandough, as one book: the land and the 1955–1988 proceedings, a chronology from 1877 to 2026, the decisive documents, our case on each of the three lines with the legal tests, what cuts against it, 64 institutions assessed, and the Missing Records, Anomalies and Source Conflicts registers. Our case, prospective. Not a finding of any court.
books.whats_new: 1.0.0: first edition. Eighteen chapters in six parts plus a one-page summary, an index of 310 evidence references and a map of all 133 source pages. Each chapter lists the source pages it draws on; paid routes are marked PAID.
